page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.se1ne.6xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 24 dedicated physical cores and 24 vCPUs, operating with a single thread per core. The instance is equipped with 192.0 GB of RAM, providing a memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, relying entirely on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 4 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates that the single-core performance of this instance is relatively weak, placing in the bottom 25% for tests like stress-ng and Geekbench single-core. However, its multi-core performance scales to average levels, as demonstrated by Geekbench multi-core and passmark CPU scores. Memory bandwidth is stable, with read-only cached small block transfers reaching 984.37 GB/sec and uncached large block transfers at 96.89 GB/sec. Database operations and Redis SET operations perform at average levels, processing 16.8 million operations per second.

Given its high memory density of 8 GB per vCPU and dedicated core allocation, the ecs.se1ne.6xlarge offers a balanced resource profile for memory-intensive workloads without the premium of GPU hardware. The lack of local storage means it is best suited for workloads utilizing network storage. It is recommended for memory-optimized tasks such as database operations, caching layers, static web serving, and moderate multi-threaded processing where single-core speed is not the primary bottleneck.
